topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: I just received a package today, and there was an odd mix of excitement and unease as I opened it. However, my heart sank when I realized the name on the label didn't match mine. It seemed the delivery was a mistake, likely meant for the person who lived here before me. I've been here only a short while, so I'm not entirely familiar with who might have been here previously. I feel it's only right to try and find the rightful owner. Perhaps I should start by checking if there are any local groups online where I might post about the mix-up. I hope I can sort this out without causing more trouble.
